```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(glmnet)
library(MASS)
library(survminer)
library(survival)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(survminer)
library(caret)
library(corrplot)
library(tibble)

# Modify patient ID
patient_id <- function(pid) {
  m <- str_match(pid, "^CAR-(\\d+)$")
  n <- as.integer(m[,2])
  ifelse(!is.na(n),
         paste("CAR", n, sep = "-"),
         NA_character_)
}

# load miRNA normalized expression
cart_mat <- read_xlsx("CAR_T_microRNA_expr_matrix.xlsx",
               sheet = "Normalizedcounts_deseq2"
               #sheet = "Raw_data"
)
cart_mat$miRNA <- gsub("-", "_", cart_mat$miRNA)
cart_mat$miRNA <- gsub("/", "_", cart_mat$miRNA)

cart_id <- patient_id(colnames(cart_mat))
cart_id <- c(colnames(cart_mat)[1], cart_id[-1])
colnames(cart_mat) <- cart_id

cart_mat <- as.data.frame(cart_mat)
rownames(cart_mat) <- cart_mat$miRNA
cart_mat$miRNA <- NULL

# micro-RNA filtering
# Every microRNA with 6 (10%) patients more zeroes is removed
cart_microRNA <- cart_mat[rowSums(cart_mat==0) < 6, ]
dim(cart_microRNA)

cart_microRNA <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(cart_microRNA)))
cart_microRNA <- cart_microRNA[order(rownames(cart_microRNA)), ]
```

```{r}
# Clinical variables
clinic_cov <- read_xlsx("clinical_covariates.xlsx")
dim(clinic_cov)
# remove unused variables
clinic_cov <- clinic_cov[, -c(16, 23:24, 26:34)]
clinic_cov <- as.data.frame(clinic_cov)
colnames(clinic_cov) <- c("patient_id","sex",
                    "age60","histology",
                    "n_lines_preAferesi","pre_aferesi_status","bridge_infusion",
                    "PET_BRIDGING","ECOG_PRELD","stage",
                    "BULKY_PRELD","DLBCL_R_IPI_PRELD","MCL_MIPI_PRELD","CAR_T_type",
                    "CAR_T_PRODUCT", "CRS","ICANS","ICANS_ricat","LDH_PRELD",
                    "FERR_PRELD","PCR_PRELD","follow_3months","pfs_status" ,"pfs_time" )
clinic_cov$follow_3months <- as.numeric(clinic_cov$follow_3months)

clinic_cov$patient_id <- patient_id(clinic_cov$patient_id)

# add sequencing batch information
seq_batch <- read_xlsx("sequencing_batch.xlsx")
seq_batch$Samples <- patient_id(seq_batch$Samples)
clinic_cov$seq_batch <- seq_batch$sequencingRun

clinic_cov <- clinic_cov[order(clinic_cov$patient_id), ]
# sex F = 1, M = 0
clinic_cov$sex[clinic_cov$sex=="F"] <- "1"
clinic_cov$sex[clinic_cov$sex=="M"] <- "0"
# histology PMBCL = 0, LBCL = 1, MCL = 2
clinic_cov$histology[clinic_cov$histology=="PMBCL"] <- "0"
clinic_cov$histology[clinic_cov$histology=="LBCL"] <- "1"
clinic_cov$histology[clinic_cov$histology=="MCL"] <- "2"
clinic_cov$histology <- as.numeric(clinic_cov$histology)
```

# Progression Free Survival
```{r}
pfs <- clinic_cov[clinic_cov$BULKY_PRELD!="ND",]
# Remove useless var
pfs$follow_3months <- NULL
pfs <- pfs[, -c(8,12:14)]
pfs$ICANS <- NULL
pfs$seq_batch <- NULL

pfs_fit <- survfit(Surv(pfs_time, pfs_status)~ 1, data = pfs)
pfs_fit
ggsurvplot(pfs_fit, conf.int = FALSE, xlab="Days", ylab="Progression Free Survival", risk.table = TRUE)

pfs_bin <- pfs
# Use median survival time
pfs_bin$risk <- pfs_bin$pfs_time
pfs_bin$risk[pfs_bin$pfs_time <= 175] <- "1" # high
pfs_bin$risk[pfs_bin$risk != "1"] <- "0" # low
table(pfs_bin$risk)

# remove pfs information
pfs_bin$pfs_status <- NULL
pfs_bin$pfs_time <- NULL

pfs_bin$risk <- as.numeric(pfs_bin$risk)

pfs_bin$BULKY_PRELD <- as.numeric(pfs_bin$BULKY_PRELD)

# Add microRNA
cart_pfs <- cart_microRNA[rownames(cart_microRNA) %in% pfs_bin$patient_id, ]
cart_pfs <- cbind(pfs_bin, cart_pfs)
```

```{r}
# Function for accuracy
err_metric <- function(CM){
  TN = CM[1,1]
  TP = CM[2,2]
  FP = CM[1,2]
  FN = CM[2,1]
  accuracy_meas <- (TP+TN)/(TP+TN+FP+FN)
  accuracy_meas <- round(accuracy_meas, 2)
}

cart_pfs$fll3_cart <- paste(cart_pfs$CAR_T_PRODUCT, cart_pfs$risk, sep = "_")
cart_pfs$fll3_cart[cart_pfs$fll3_cart=="1_0"] <- "cart1_0"
cart_pfs$fll3_cart[cart_pfs$fll3_cart=="0_0"] <- "cart0_0"
cart_pfs$fll3_cart[cart_pfs$fll3_cart=="0_1"] <- "cart0_1"
cart_pfs$fll3_cart[cart_pfs$fll3_cart=="1_1"] <- "cart1_1"

accuracy <- data.frame(accuracy=NA)
discovery <- test <- train <- valid <- cv_glmnet <- y_pred <- y_valid <- pred <- y <- list()
set.seed(333)
inTrain <- createDataPartition(
    y = cart_pfs$fll3_cart,
    p = .75,
    list = FALSE
)
  
discovery <- cart_pfs[inTrain,]
test <- cart_pfs[-inTrain,]
   
n <- 100000
for (i in 1:n) {
  inTrain <- createDataPartition(
    y = discovery$fll3_cart,
    p = .75,
    list = FALSE
  )
  train[[i]] <- discovery[inTrain,]
  train[[i]]$patient_id <- NULL
  train[[i]]$fll3_cart <- NULL
  valid[[i]] <- discovery[-inTrain,]
  valid[[i]]$patient_id <- NULL
  valid[[i]]$fll3_cart <- NULL
}
```

```{r}
for (i in seq_along(train)) {
  set.seed(333)
  foldid <- sample(rep(seq(5), length.out = nrow(train[[i]][,-16])))
  cv_glmnet[[i]] <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(train[[i]][,-16]), train[[i]][,16], family =  "binomial", foldid = foldid, alpha = 0.3)

  pred[[i]] <- predict(cv_glmnet[[i]], newx = as.matrix(valid[[i]][,-16]), type = "response", s = "lambda.min")
  pred[[i]] <- as.data.frame(pred[[i]])
  pred[[i]]$lambda.min[pred[[i]]$lambda.min>=0.5] <- 1
  pred[[i]]$lambda.min[pred[[i]]$lambda.min<0.5] <- 0

  y_valid[[i]] <- valid[[i]]$risk
  y_pred[[i]] <- pred[[i]]$lambda.min
  y[[i]] <- as.data.frame(cbind(y_valid[[i]], y_pred[[i]]))
  colnames(y[[i]]) <- c("y_real", "y_pred")

  accuracy[i,] <- err_metric(table(factor(y[[i]]$y_real, levels= 0:1), factor(y[[i]]$y_pred, levels= 0:1)))
  
}  

accuracy$iter <- lapply(seq_along(train), function(i) paste("iter", i, sep = "_"))

table(accuracy$accuracy)
summary(accuracy$accuracy)

hist(accuracy$accuracy, breaks = 20)

n_coef <- data.frame(n_coef=NA)
coef <- list()
for(i in seq_along(cv_glmnet)){
  coef[[i]] <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(coef(cv_glmnet[[i]], s ="lambda.min")))
  coef[[i]]$var <- rownames(coef[[i]])

  coef[[i]] <- coef[[i]][abs(coef[[i]]$s1)>0, ]

  coef[[i]] <- coef[[i]]$var
  n_coef[i, ] <- length(coef[[i]])
}
n_coef$seq <- seq_along(cv_glmnet)
n_coef <- n_coef[n_coef$n_coef>0,]
coef <- coef[as.numeric(n_coef$seq)]

var <- colnames(cart_pfs[,-16])
times <- lapply(var, function(x) grep(x, coef))
names(times) <- var
times <- lapply(times, function(x) 100*length(x)/length(seq_along(cv_glmnet)))

df <- data.frame(times = sapply(times, c), var=var)
df <- df[order(df$times, decreasing = TRUE),]
df$type <- df$var
df$type[grep("hsa", df$var)] <- "mirna"
df$type[df$type!="mirna"] <- "clinic"

df1 <- df[df$times>=10,]
ggplot(df1, aes(x=reorder(var, times, decreasing = TRUE), y=times, fill=type)) + geom_col(width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0)) + ylim(0,100) + labs(x=NULL) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90), text=element_text(size=15))
```

```{r}
discovery_slc <- discovery[, c("risk", df1$var)]

fit_glm <- glm(risk ~., data = discovery_slc, family = "binomial")
summary(fit_glm)

test$patient_id <- NULL
y_real <- test$risk
y_pred <- round(predict(fit_glm, newdata = test[,-c(16)], type = "response"))

accuracy_final_model <- err_metric(table(factor(y_real, levels= 0:1), factor(y_pred, levels= 0:1)))
accuracy_final_model
```

```{r}
discovery_slc <- discovery[, c("risk", df1[1:4,]$var)]

fit_glm1 <- glm(risk ~., data = discovery_slc, family = "binomial")
summary(fit_glm1)

test$patient_id <- NULL
y_real <- test$risk
y_pred <- round(predict(fit_glm1, newdata = test[,-c(16)], type = "response"))

accuracy_final_model <- err_metric(table(factor(y_real, levels= 0:1), factor(y_pred, levels= 0:1)))
accuracy_final_model
anova(fit_glm, fit_glm1, test = "Chisq")
```
